name: Ad Mortem
storyline:
Contrara has fallen.

Entropy ravages the land. Once-green fields now lay blackened and arid, flora contorts and mutates as its pestilent roots sprawl towards unsoiled ground, and bloodthirsty monsters are borne from placid livestock.

You are a Vessel. A byproduct of the death of the Old Gods, your hollow soul prevents your passage into the afterlife, binding you to this world.

Fated to an eternity of conflict, you must master the art of melee combat and rise through the ranks of your faction– or face annihilation at the hands of your enemies.

Whether you side with the great castles of the Palisadeans or the snarling beasts of the Hantrii, find your role in the battle and lead the charge through this broken world. Take up your weapon…

And may death find you.
summary: Ad Mortem is a brutal multiplayer medieval Melee Slasher set in the corrupted world of Contrara. You play as a Vessel, a byproduct of the death of the Old Gods. Your hollow soul prevents your passage into the afterlife, binding you to this world. Through this eternal struggle, you will engage in team-based PvP combat against other Vessels upon the ravaged battlefields of the two warring factions; the Palisadean and the Hantrii. Fight with your allies, slay monsters and men, and delve into the dungeons of the Deities in a mad quest of retribution and power.
